answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The harbor cap is policed at intake and inlet exposes the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a glacier tag. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
